note: macOS exposes no public API that reports whether the screen is being captured, so this is a heuristic. It is deliberately conservative: a false positive silently postpones a break, which is worse than missing one share. Signatures whose app runs persistently in the background — Loom, CleanShot X, Kap — are listed with "enabled": false, because the app merely running is not evidence that anything is being recorded, and no process that appears only during a recording has been verified for them. Zoom and Teams run all day too, but both spawn a share helper that exists only while a share is live, so they are gated on that.

signatures.name: Loom
signatures.disabledReason: Loom idles in the background with its recorder helper already running, so its presence says nothing about whether a recording is live.

signatures.name: CleanShot X
signatures.disabledReason: Runs as a menu-bar agent all day; the recorder helper name has not been verified against a live recording.
